prompt: Fix Ledger(ttl, capacity).claim(key, payload, now) for duplicate request suppression. ttl and capacity are positive integers (reject bool), otherwise constructor raises ValueError. now is a caller-provided integer clock; no wall clock access. A new key returns True, records a deep snapshot of payload, and expires at now+ttl. An unexpired identical payload returns False WITHOUT extending its expiry. An unexpired different payload raises ValueError. Expiry is inclusive: at now >= expiry it is a new claim. Remove expired entries before capacity checks; a new live key at full capacity raises OverflowError without evicting live entries. Payloads are JSON-compatible dicts; caller mutations must not change stored snapshots. A conflict or capacity failure must not extend or overwrite live entries. All scenarios use nondecreasing now values. Modify only ledger.py and optional tests/*.py. Preserve the public API. No dependency installation or commits.
